character: Best-value base in Les 3 Vallées. Functional 1970s architecture with newer chalet-style additions. Awarded Famille Plus label. 94% visitor satisfaction.
description: Les Menuires is the most affordable base in Les 3 Vallées at 1,850m. Purpose-built in the 1970s with functional concrete architecture, newer chalet-style hotels (Reberty, Les Bruyères) have improved the look. 94% visitor satisfaction. Famille Plus label. Unpretentious, cosmopolitan, family-friendly. Good links to Méribel and the full 600km 3V domain.
sources: Les Menuires official press kit 2026-2027 PDF

villages.name: Les Menuires Centre (Croisette)
villages.character: Central area, functional 1970s architecture, shops, restaurants, services, Le Break sports centre

villages.name: Reberty
villages.character: Quieter satellite, newer chalet-style buildings, ski-in/ski-out

villages.name: Les Bruyères
villages.character: Quiet suburb, La Bulle aquatic centre, modern chalets

non_ski_activities.la_belle_vie: Unique wellness centre in St-Martin area. Indoor pool, waterfalls, massage jets, heated Nordic pool, hammam, themed saunas, Cosy Bar. €9.50 pool / €29 wellness / €42.80 6-day pass.
non_ski_activities.le_break: Croisette — water park with pool, waterfalls, paddling pool, wellness (saunas, hammam, jacuzzis). €9.50/€42.80.
non_ski_activities.la_bulle: Les Bruyères — aquatic play area, lazy river, water games, balneo pool, sauna, hammam, jacuzzi, tea room. €9.50/€42.80.
non_ski_activities.roc_seven: Highest Italian restaurant in 3V at 2,300m. Live music at 2pm daily. Panoramic valley views. Pizzas, lasagne.
non_ski_activities.fahrenheit_seven: New 4-star ski-in/ski-out hotel (opened Dec 2026). 51 rooms, neo-vintage design. Heated indoor pool, sauna, steam room. Italian/Mediterranean cuisine. 200m² south-facing terrace with DJs. From €300/night incl breakfast.
non_ski_activities.chez_pepe_nicolas: Family farm — cheese cellar dining at altitude. 4 generations of alpine farmers. Alpine cheese tasting (tommes, raclette, sérac). Thursdays 6pm, €50/2hrs incl tastings.
non_ski_activities.la_marmite: Maître Restaurateur certified. Igloo dining — raclette/fondue in transformed gondola cabins. Set menu €52 / child €22.
non_ski_activities.yogiski_week: 11th edition 4-9 April 2027. Yoga at 2,800m, sound baths, Ayurveda, cold yoga, Tai Chi. Skiing included.
non_ski_activities.other: Boukty Camp tobogganing, snow groomer rides, snowmobiling, dog sledding, meeting an alpine farmer, cinema, ski touring, cross-country skiing, heritage trail, Notre-Dame-de-la-Vie baroque sanctuary

honest_drawbacks: Quieter apres than Méribel/VT (but Roc Seven lively)
